title: Location Atlas
dek: A nested atlas of Fenumion’s regions, settlements, ruins, estates, forests, civic spaces, and other named places.

facts.Maps: 10 interactive maps · world, regions and local views
facts.Provenance: Campaign records, maps, and preserved images

body:
Start with a region, then explore its settlements and landmarks. Pristinia and Eovar Harbor are locations within Prima. Caisleán na Brón belongs to Fein Uaill; Hope and the Tower lie within Gael; Pristinia’s civic sites belong to Prima.

Find a place
